summary:
Generac獲利大超預期、營收年增逾12%，住宅備援電源與儲能需求回溫帶動成長。
• 營收10.6億美元，年增12.44%，住宅備援需求回升
• EPS 1.80美元，優於預估1.33美元，意外幅度35.49%
• 電網不穩與極端天氣推升備援發電機需求
• 儲能與潔淨能源產品線拓展成長動能
• 毛利改善與成本控制帶動獲利超預期
ai_view:
訊號正面：獲利大超預期35%且營收恢復雙位數成長，顯示住宅備援去庫存結束、需求回溫，毛利改善佐證營運槓桿。短期股價有業績支撐，惟84.49倍本益比偏高，已部分反映復甦預期。中期關鍵在於需求是否來自結構性電網脆弱化而非一次性天氣事件，以及儲能（如PWRcell）滲透。建議追蹤經銷商庫存、住宅與商工占比、毛利率與利率對安裝需求的影響。

需留意：業績受天氣與停電事件影響，週期性與波動大；本益比84.49倍偏高，需求若回落估值承壓；儲能市場競爭與利率敏感的住宅安裝需求變數

summary_en:
Generac beat strongly with 12%+ revenue growth as residential backup power and energy-storage demand recover.
• Revenue of $1.06B, up 12.44% YoY as residential backup demand recovers
• EPS of $1.80 beat the $1.33 estimate, a 35.49% surprise
• Grid instability and extreme weather lift demand for backup generators
• Energy storage and clean-energy product lines broaden growth
• Margin improvement and cost control drive the earnings beat

ai_view_en:
Positive signal: a 35% earnings beat with revenue back to double-digit growth suggests residential-backup destocking has ended and demand is recovering, with margin gains confirming operating leverage. The stock has near-term support, but 84.49x PE is elevated and partly prices in recovery. Mid-term hinges on whether demand stems from structural grid fragility rather than one-off weather, plus storage (PWRcell) adoption. Track dealer inventory, residential vs. C&I mix, gross margin, and rate effects on installs.

Watch：Results depend on weather and outage events, creating cyclicality and volatility; PE of 84.49x is elevated; valuation at risk if demand cools; Storage-market competition and rate-sensitive residential installs add variability
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 1.80美元優於預估1.33美元，意外幅度35.49%，營收年增12.44%。
